about:
Earth Ranch operates from Jackson, Wisconsin, as a U.S.-based organic snack manufacturer and food co-packer. The company specializes in clean-label dehydrated snacks, sprouted nuts, clusters, and trail mixes, serving both emerging and established brands through private label manufacturing, co-packing, and product development services.

Its product range spans trail mixes, clusters and bites, granolas, dehydrated fruit bars, functional fruit-based bars, sprouted seeds and nuts, crackers, and other functional snacks. The facility is peanut-free and offers packaging options including gusseted pouches, pillow packs, and bar wrappers. Minimum order quantities run from 10,000 to 20,000 units depending on the product.

Earth Ranch works with brands across the organic, plant-based, gluten-free, non-GMO, keto, paleo, vegan, and kosher snack categories. Customers include companies seeking a co-manufacturing partner for dehydrated foods or a private label producer to bring custom formulations to market, with the option to select from a ready-to-ship catalog or develop new products.

The company emphasizes a value-added dehydration approach and a clean-label philosophy, highlighting attributes such as added protein, grain-free, and exotic flavors. Its differentiation rests on a peanut-free facility, a broad portfolio of dietary certifications and claims, and a development process that moves ideas from concept to shelf-ready products.
